scope: Native scenario methods and external report admission
evidence: REST/MCP writes preserve manual and integration scenario types while authoring inspection and automated methods; stale version is 409, unknown method and authority extras are 422.
Planning considers the complete population and installed verifier capability. Unsupported or absent methods stay blocking; scenario type is not used to infer a method or grant evidence.

Real HTTP execution receipts and signed inspection/static-analysis/demonstration reports bind method, scenario semantics, criterion scope and author. Tampered fields and method reinterpretation are refused.

Added three REST refusals for static reports missing sources, rules or configuration: no receipt emitted and persisted snapshot/history unchanged. Unauthorized inspection and foreign scope also fail before receipt creation.

External reports use the existing scoped status writer and Test Card delivery chain. Stale/failed/nonconclusive observations invalidate credit without closing the Spec. Unsigned or forged bulk evidence is refused.

Frontend sends unchanged server-issued evidence, separates admission from persistence, preserves permission/version boundaries and displays inconclusive/aborted/unavailable as pending rather than passing.
limits: REST and MCP identities are controlled fixtures; not an installed credential lifecycle or full browser E2E.

Accepted implementation facts and scenario states are seeded in the delivery-chain fixture. AC-VER-14 remains pending its complete technical-requirement delivery witness; report-admission evidence alone is not that qualification.
No product/SPA change, conversion, promotion or real-data operation. Main86 closure stays applicable with eight zero budgets.
